about: v8_s1: scene 1 of the Google film, feeling first (paint_test/v8_card.md). One camera on the canal-side street at a seated person's eye height, looking along the canal to the low October sun; the Google building's glass wall cut by the left edge; her a few steps out of its lit door. Metres: X right, Y up, Z forward; the street at Y 0, the canal's water at Y -1. Shared by the engine (src/look/v8_s1/*.tsx) and the bake (src/look/v8_s1/bake/*.py).
